note: The game is pitch black until you scan, and the bundled headless Chromium renders WebGL in software, so the shot is made with the game's own GPU tool. From the game folder: S=$(tail -n +2 Niepotrzebne/tools/showcase.js); DPR=2 node Niepotrzebne/tools/shot.mjs 'https://lidar.gzowo.fun/?solo=1&auto=1&play=1&seed=5&dpr=2' Niepotrzebne/shots/hero.png "<wait for game.state === 'play'>|||$S('corridor')|||$S('hall')|||$S('bottom')" 150 1200 900. showcase.js freezes the creature in a corridor, adds one fake operator, paints the room with pulses and returns right after the last one (blue and red traces fade within 3 s). Then: node tools/shot.mjs set --slug lidar-point-cloud-001 --frame <hero-1.png>. The published frame is the 'corridor' scene.
